sections.A: Whiplash gaari ke accident (aksar peeche se takkar) mein gardan ke tezi se aage-peeche jhatke se hone wali chot hai. Is ke baad ke symptoms ko WAD kehte hain.
sections.B: Gardan ka dard aur akdan ghanton ya ek din mein shuru hota hai. Sar dard, kandhe aur upper back ka dard, chakkar, neend aur gaari chalane ka darr bhi ho sakta hai. Baazu mein jhunjhunahat grade III ka ishara hai.
sections.C: Accident kaise hua, dard kab shuru hua, kya numbness ya kamzori hai, aur kya chakkar ya sar ki chot hai: yeh sawaal fracture aur grade ka andaza dete hain.
sections.D: Pehle Canadian C-spine rule se faisla karein ke imaging chahiye ya nahi. Jab tak clear na ho, gardan na hilayein. Phir movement, neuro exam aur gehri muscles ki jaanch.
sections.E: Canadian C-spine rule qadam ba qadam batata hai ke kab X-ray zaroori hai. Step 1 ya 2 fail ho to gardan ki range test na karein aur imaging karwayein.
sections.F: Fracture, radiculopathy, concussion aur artery ki chot ko rule out karna zaroori hai.
sections.G: Reedh ki hadi par dard, 65 se zyada umar, haath-pair mein jhunjhunahat, chakkar ya double vision, behoshi: yeh emergency hai.
sections.H: Flowchart: pehle C-spine rule, phir neuro signs, phir vascular ya sar ki chot, phir grade II ka diagnosis, phir lambe dard ke risk factors, aur aakhir mein education aur exercise.
sections.I: Gardan aur thoracic ki halki mobilisation thori der ka aaraam deti hai. Shuruaat education aur active exercise se karein, manual therapy sirf madadgar hai.
sections.J: Active movement, deep neck flexor training, scapular exercises, chakkar ho to gaze aur JPE training, aur aam walking jaisi activity.
sections.K: Soft collar recommend nahi. Garmi aur TENS sirf aaraam ke liye.
sections.L: Pehle 2 hafte: serious chot rule out karein, tasalli dein, active rahein. 2 se 12 hafte: exercise barhayein. Uske baad bhi masla ho to multidisciplinary approach.
sections.M: NDI, dard, rotation aur CCFT note karein. 6 se 12 hafte mein behtari na ho aur pareshani zyada ho to team approach.
sections.N: 29 saal ki khatoon ko peeche se halki takkar lagi. Pehle khud socho ke imaging chahiye ya nahi, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: C-spine rule se screen karein, phir tasalli aur active movement. Manual therapy sirf saath mein.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
